heading: EXT. TORTOISE MARKET - GIANT SHELL - DAWN

units.text: EXT. TORTOISE MARKET - GIANT SHELL - DAWN
A colossal tortoise, patient as a hill, plods across a salt flat.
On its domed shell, a market of striped awnings and lanterns sways to each slow step.
Five merchants cluster at the crest.
MAEVE THORNWICK (50s, spice-seller, apron stained saffron).
Her apprentice KIT (teens, wiry, a pouch of glass beads).
Rival glassblower DOMINIC ASHFORD (40s, sooty, barrel-chested).
Cloth-weaver LADY ISOLDE (60s, veil of spun silver).
And the market's crier, OLD PERRIN (80s, a hand bell).
The ground trembles.
The tortoise slows.
Hold your wares! She's stopping!
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Stopping! Stopping!
units.name: PERRIN

units.text: Is she sick?
units.name: KIT

units.text: She's listening. Quiet now.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Last time she stopped, we lost half the lanterns.
units.name: DOMINIC

units.text: Then keep your mouth shut, and perhaps we keep the other half.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: Old witch.
units.name: DOMINIC

units.text: I heard that.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: A deep groan rolls through the shell.
Crates slide.
A lantern shatters.
Brace! Brace!
units.name: PERRIN

units.text: Don't fall, don't fall, don't fall.
units.name: KIT

units.text: Everyone, hands on the rails! Now!
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: The tortoise rises on its legs, lifting the whole market toward the sky.
